phase1_execution_policy.reason: Reuse the completed corrected v2 evidence without spending the Phase 1 zero-rerun budget.

phase_0.basis: Functional contract and golden trajectories are present.

phase_1.basis: Corrected v2 timing handoff and three archived HSPICE scenario results pass static integrity checks.

phase_3.basis: Recorded sequencer unit-test result is GO.

phase_4.basis: Recorded three nominal FSM trajectories and eight failure results are passing.

phase_5.basis: Recorded integrated nominal results are passing with exact operation counts.

phase_6.basis: Existing result claims GO but only ten assertion classes and four negative scenarios are evidenced; the plan requires sixteen assertion classes and eight negative scenarios.

phase_7.basis: Existing machine result is INFRASTRUCTURE_READY and lacks complete 1 GHz closure, fanout, warnings, cell-usage, and q_final path evidence.

phase_8.basis: Current mapped netlist passes functional and MAX-SDF GLS for all three nominal scenarios and all eight negative scenarios; exact nominal operations are 45/36/36 with one S_CLK and two Q samples per probe.

phase_9.basis: Three integrated transistor-level decks were rendered and frozen, but the first 0.80 V HSPICE transient was explicitly terminated before acceptance; no autonomous mixed-signal GO is claimed.

phase_10.basis: Final acceptance and handoff report are not yet publishable.

historical_phase_1_v1.consumption_rule: Historical v1 evidence is retained for traceability and is not consumed by RTL or later gates.
